api-latency-after-release.name: API latency after release
api-latency-after-release.summary: p95 latency rose after a rollout while database saturation stayed normal.

logs.message: Upstream inventory request exceeded 2500 ms timeout
Retry budget exhausted for inventory client

runbook.step: Compare the affected request path and dependency latency with the last known-good release.
A rollback requires incident commander approval and an explicit change record.

diagnosis.summary: Checkout requests are waiting on a slow inventory dependency after the latest release.

proposed_action.name: roll back checkout-api release 8f2c
proposed_action.description: Simulate a rollback to the previous known-good release, then recheck p95 latency.
proposed_action.impact: Changes the checkout-api release state in the simulator only.

payment-connection-pool.name: Payment database pool exhausted
payment-connection-pool.summary: payment requests fail while active connections reach the configured pool cap.

logs.message: active connection count reached max pool size 80
request handler waiting for database connection

runbook.step: Check connection checkout duration and long-running queries before changing pool size.
Do not raise the connection limit without database capacity review and approval.

diagnosis.summary: The payment service is queuing requests because its database connection pool is saturated.

proposed_action.name: enable payment queue backpressure
proposed_action.description: Simulate reducing new payment work until active connections return below the pool threshold.
proposed_action.impact: The simulator records a controlled load-shedding action without touching a live system.

auth-certificate-expiry.name: Authentication certificate renewal failure
auth-certificate-expiry.summary: authentication requests fail with certificate validity errors shortly after renewal.

logs.message: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid
token exchange returned status 401 for 37 percent of requests

runbook.step: Validate certificate chain, issuer, not-before, and not-after timestamps.
Credential rotation requires security owner review and approval.

diagnosis.summary: The identity gateway is rejecting requests because certificate renewal failed and the active certificate is expired.

proposed_action.name: stage certificate renewal
proposed_action.description: Simulate staging a renewed certificate for security review before activation.
proposed_action.impact: Only records a staged change in the simulator; no certificate is issued or installed.

queue-backlog.name: Worker queue backlog
queue-backlog.summary: background jobs accumulate while worker heartbeat rate falls.

logs.message: out of memory while building quarterly export

runbook.step: Inspect recent worker restarts and memory pressure before scaling consumers.
Scaling or replaying jobs requires an owner-approved change.

diagnosis.summary: Report workers are restarting under memory pressure, reducing consumption and creating a growing backlog.

proposed_action.name: pause large report jobs and scale workers
proposed_action.description: Simulate pausing large exports and adding two workers after a capacity check.
proposed_action.impact: The simulator records the proposed capacity response without changing a queue or worker pool.
